title: Reusable README technique registry
summary: Maintain evidence-linked README techniques and combinations with stable IDs on the separate README-Technique-Library branch. The original README HQ registry remains available for historical evidence and snapshot checks.
acceptance_criteria: The dedicated library is the maintained source for technique and combination definitions.
The library supports searching stable IDs, reader tasks, and aliases, including separate discovery of retired records.
The README HQ guide routes current choices to the library and documents the role of the historical registry.

evidence.claim: The published technique guide links the registry and defines reuse and evidence rules.
The dedicated library publishes the catalog and its search interface.
The guide routes current choices to the library and identifies the older registry as historical.
